vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (2 sticks now.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Hmm. That fits what I've been seeing. Let me think about the mechanism..."
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Ethan, Seymour, Esmeralda and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down. Ethan, Seymour, Esmeralda, Victor are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ethan, Seymour, Esmeralda and Baglan met them at the door — 3 put down. Esmeralda didn't come back. Ethan, Seymour, Baglan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Seymour just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Baglan just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ethan, Seymour, Baglan and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down. Ethan, Seymour, Victor are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
